Even after retirement, I stayed at home, managing the household and keeping the family’s traditions alive. I never had a driver’s license, and I have always relied on public transit or family members for transportation. Living with a hearing impairment and a mental and emotional disability has shaped much of my daily routine. I’m working hard to finish my education, build a stable career in retail and food service, and keep my home comfortable and affordable.
